user.title: Connect to OpenSprinkler
user.description: Soil moisture readings need OpenSprinklerShop firmware 2.3.0 or newer with the Analog Sensor API. "Last on" times work on any firmware.

data_description.host: IP address or URL of the controller, e.g. 192.168.1.50 or opensprinkler.local:8080
data_description.password: The device password, or its MD5 hash. Only the hash is stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the OpenSprinkler password
reauth_confirm.description: The controller at {url} rejected the stored password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to an OpenSprinkler controller at that address.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
